verdict.rationale: Gitea documents its own API for extending functionality and building custom workflows (gitea-docs-4), so programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API matches the UI feature for feature, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec at the docs paths checked. The official CLI and MCP server are adjacent tools and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for all UI features (repos, PRs, issues, Actions, packages, admin config), a discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent confirmation of API–UI parity.
